data: TrashNet photos of 4 materials (plastic, paper, glass, metal): 1390 for training
evaluation: TrashNet's own test list, 332 images, never used for fitting
model: logistic regression on 32x24 RGB pixels + HSV colour histogram (no deep learning)
limitation: one object per photo on a white posterboard in good light; real bins have mixed, dirty, crumpled items on busy backgrounds, so this score does not show how the system would work in a real sorting setting
